subject.title: fix(workboard): avoid duplicate proof entries on completion

question: Should the Workboard tool contract formally expose `proofId` as the durable completion-correlation mechanism while keeping existing `workboard_proof` consumers compatible?
rationale: The bug fix relies on a new public input/output contract rather than an internal-only implementation detail, and the related issue also raises the intended meaning of worker-reported proof status.

options.title: Approve the narrow correlation contract
options.body: Keep `proofId` as the supported lifecycle token, preserve existing response compatibility, and require current-head proof before merge.

options.title: Keep completion append-only
options.body: Decline correlation and leave independently recorded completion proof as separate immutable history entries.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow correlation contract
recommendation.body: Keep `proofId` as the supported lifecycle token, preserve existing response compatibility, and require current-head proof before merge.
